name: Stats Band - Six Figures In Two Rows At iPad Width
description: The homepage numbers band at 768px (iPad portrait) since the October 2026 all-hands added a sixth figure. One row of six would need ~1175px even with 32px gutters, and "10,000+" alone is ~180px wide, so from 761px to 1200px the band wraps to two rows of three with a rule between them instead of pushing the page into a sideways scroll.
